speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Past the stair. The porch is the next thing, and I am not stopping in Chapel Street to improve a Sunday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have stepped past it. The porch is in front of us. I am not turning my head.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: Hamnet is off the block. We are a line again.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: I was only looking at the white. The white is not a lesson.
